name: Ottie's Boots
description: A collier's boots, cracked at the toe, the laces tied together so they carry as a pair. They sat on the log seat of the cold hut in the clearing. Hob Marl held them out into the fog at the clearing's edge until they went cold and silver: now they hold everything Hob remembers of the four colliers who went up after the Lamp, and the waiting with it. A Remnant, made on purpose.
